sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. No.307 of 2018 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C. Kashipur arising out of Tikiri P.S. Case No.99 of 2018 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 420/417/34 of IPC.
3.

Learned counsel for the State seeks an adjournment to obtain instruction regarding the role ascribed to the Petitioner in commission of offence so also as to whether there is any money trail into her account.
Learned counsel for the State is requested to obtain up-to- date Case Diary in the meanwhile.
5. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
6. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
7. Copy of this order be made over to the learned counsel for the State.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Seema Singh vs State Of Odisha ....
